study_identification_part.si3_author_journal_year: Di Biase et al., Molecular Psychiatry, 2022
study_identification_part.si4_title: Cell type-specific manifestations of cortical thickness heterogeneity in schizophrenia

cm1_research_objectives.reason: The study clearly states its objective to determine if cortical thickness heterogeneity in schizophrenia relates to interregional variation in neural cell types and to characterize this heterogeneity using normative modeling.
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: Here, we sought to determine whether cortical thickness (CTh) heterogeneity in schizophrenia relates to interregional variation in distinct neural cell types... To characterize CTh heterogeneity, normative ranges were established for 34 cortical regions and the extent of deviation from these ranges was measured for each individual with schizophrenia.

HCP-Young Adult Sample and HCP-psychosis... n = 1267 comprising 140 cases... and 1127 controls... ASRB... n = 520 comprising 335 cases... and 185 controls... For the HCP-1200 cohort, subjects with documented brain anatomical, processing or noise issues (n=151)... were excluded

nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.reason: The normative model explicitly includes age and sex as covariates. Site effects were handled using ComBat harmonization.
nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.supporting_text: Quantile regression [18] was used to obtain a normative range of regional CTh variation as a function of age and sex [3]... Regional CTh estimates were retrospectively harmonized with ComBat [7] to alleviate possible site-related differences
nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.location: DiBiase2022.pdf.md: Methods - Deriving regional deviation profiles of CTh; 41380_2022_1460_MOESM1_ESM.pdf.md: Supplementary Material - Harmonization

nm3_data_sources_reference_cohort.reason: The data sources (HCP-Young Adult, HCP-Psychosis, ASRB) are clearly identified.
nm3_data_sources_reference_cohort.supporting_text: This study comprised a total of 1849 participants drawn from three independent datasets: (1) the Human Connectome Project-Young Adult Sample [15]; (2) the Human Connectome Project for Early Psychosis (HCPpsychosis) [16]; and (3) the Australian Schizophrenia Research Bank (ASRB) [17].

nm4_image_acquisition_protocol.reason: The imaging modality (T1-weighted MRI) and specific acquisition parameters (resolution, TR, TE) for each dataset are described in the supplementary material.
nm4_image_acquisition_protocol.supporting_text: T1-weighted brain MRI scans were acquired as follows: HCP-1200 (3T Connectome Siemens Skyra: Voxel resolution=.7mm 3 , TR=2400ms, TE=2.14ms); HCP-Psychosis (Siemens MAGNETOM Prisma 3T: Voxel resolution=.8mm 3 , TR=2400ms, TE=2.22ms); and ASRB (Siemens Avanto 1.5T: Voxel resolution=1mm 3 , TR=1980ms, TE=4.3ms).
nm4_image_acquisition_protocol.location: 41380_2022_1460_MOESM1_ESM.pdf.md: Supplementary Material - MRI acquisition, processing, and harmonization

nm5_data_preprocessing.reason: The preprocessing software (FreeSurfer v5.3 and v6) and steps (intensity normalization, skull stripping, etc.) are described.
nm5_data_preprocessing.supporting_text: T1-weighted images for these datasets were processed using FreeSurfer version 5.3 [4]. For all three datasets, preprocessing included intensity normalization, nonbrain tissue removal and spatial normalization to Talairach-like space.

nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.reason: The study does not explicitly describe a data partitioning strategy (e.g., cross-validation) for the construction of the normative model itself within the reference cohort. It mentions checking coverage on the healthy individuals, but implies this is on the full set used for fitting.
nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.supporting_text: For all cortical regions, more than 90% of the healthy individuals resided within the normative range, confirming the accuracy of the normative models.
nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.location: DiBiase2022.pdf.md: Results - Heterogeneity in individual CTh deviation profiles
